ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of high-intensity pixels (white) to low-intensity pixels (black); approximately 80% of the visible surface is white, with black pigmentation concentrated at the margins and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation bands along the entire trailing edge; a distinct vertical dark band extending from the median notch toward the peduncle; scattered dark focal spots (mottling) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees; depth of notch is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing edge boundary; contains multiple jagged peaks and deep valleys with non-uniform pixel amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory originating at the median notch, transitioning into a slightly convex curve toward the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular dark pixel clusters (scarring) visible on the medial and distal regions of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, cutting through the primary white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface; irregular tearing/erosion visible at the tips of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric trailing edge profile with more pronounced serration peaks on the right lobe tip compared to the left.
